const array = [1];
Object.setPrototypeOf(array, Object.create(Array.prototype, {0: {value: 99, enumerable: true}, length: {value: 8}}));
console.dir(array, {showHidden: true});
const text = new String("a");
Object.setPrototypeOf(text, Object.create(String.prototype, {0: {value: "z", enumerable: true}, length: {value: 8}}));
console.dir(text, {showHidden: true});
const protoArray = [9];
const child = Object.create(protoArray);
console.dir(child, {showHidden: true});
const intermediate = Object.create(protoArray, {0: {value: 3}, length: {value: 2}});
console.dir(Object.create(intermediate), {showHidden: true});
